blocks.name: ula32
blocks.responsibility: Select and execute one combinational arithmetic, logical, or comparison operation.
blocks.design_rationale: A single combinational block has zero cycle latency (NFR-01), while numeric_std and no vendor primitives preserve synthesis portability (NFR-02).

alternatives.name: pipelined_ula32
alternatives.tradeoff: Could shorten the combinational critical path at a high clock rate, but adds registers, area, clocking, and one or more cycles of latency; rejected by NFR-01.
